content.short: SecureTrace is a blockchain forensic tool that uses AI and machine learning to analyze transactions.
content.description: SecureTrace is a blockchain forensic tool that uses AI and machine learning to analyze transactions. It emphasizes post-transaction review and forensic thread tracing, with Auto-Trace as a standout feature that automates the tracing of transactions, saving time and effort for investigators. By applying specialized blockchain forensic techniques to transaction data, SecureTrace enables deeper examination of transaction trails, helps reveal intricate patterns, and highlights potential vulnerabilities in on-chain activity.
